Historical Indigenous people

Mugulasha

The Inter-Tribal Council of Louisiana’s history records the Mugulasha living with the Bayogoula in 1699 in the area now known as Bayou Goula. Glen G. Fredlund’s research discusses the shared village in his study of the Bayou Goula area.
